segments.sn37.10:1.1: “Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo … pe … nirayaṃ upapajjati.
segments.sn37.10:1.3: Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, dussīlo ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti – imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo … pe … nirayaṃ upapajjatī”ti.
